class.name: AudioMixerChannel
class.description: An [AudioMixerChannel] defines one named channel of the [AudioMixerServer], for example [code]music[/code], [code]ambience[/code] or [code]voice[/code]: the audio bus it plays on, its volume and pitch, how many one-shots may overlap, and what happens at the end of its queue. Channels are usually collected in an [AudioMixerLayout] that is loaded at startup (project setting [code]audio/mixer/default_layout[/code]), but they can also be added from code with [method AudioMixerServer.add_channel]. The channel plays on an existing bus of the [AudioServer]. The mixer never creates, removes or changes buses; the bus volume (for example a player's music volume) multiplies with the channel volume. [b]Note:[/b] Changing a property of a channel that is already added to the [AudioMixerServer] does not change running voices. Call [method AudioMixerServer.add_channel] again with the changed channel to apply it.

members.member: The audio bus the channel plays on. If the bus does not exist when a voice starts, the voice plays on [code]Master[/code] and a warning is printed once.
The name of the channel, used as key in all [AudioMixerServer] methods. It must not be empty.

The cross-fade time in seconds used by [method AudioMixerServer.next], [method AudioMixerServer.previous] and [method AudioMixerServer.change_index] when their [code]fade_time[/code] is negative, and by [member stop_on_scene_change]. [code]0.0[/code] switches at once.

If [code]true[/code], the current entry starts again when it ends instead of advancing the queue. The restart happens in the next frame; for a seamless loop, use the loop setting of the stream itself (for example [member AudioStreamWAV.loop_mode]).

If [code]true[/code], the channel pauses while [member SceneTree.paused] is [code]true[/code] and resumes with the tree. If [code]false[/code], the channel keeps playing, for example music in a pause menu. Has no effect when the main loop is not a [SceneTree].
The pitch and tempo of the channel, as in [member AudioStreamPlayer.pitch_scale]. Must be greater than [code]0.0[/code].

The maximum number of one-shots started with [method AudioMixerServer.play_one_shot] that play at the same time on this channel. When another one starts, the oldest one is stopped. Ranges from [code]1[/code] to [code]128[/code].

If [code]true[/code], the next queue entry given as a path is loaded in the background (with [method ResourceLoader.load_threaded_request]) while the current entry plays, so switching does not block. Not used in [constant QUEUE_MODE_SHUFFLE]. In exports without threads (the default Web export), the load still runs on the main thread, only earlier.
What happens when an entry of the queue ends. See [enum QueueMode].

If [code]true[/code], voices that were started in another scene than the current one are stopped (with a fade of [member default_fade_time]) after [method SceneTree.change_scene_to_file] or [method SceneTree.change_scene_to_packed]. If [code]false[/code], the channel keeps playing across scene changes. Has no effect when the main loop is not a [SceneTree].
The initial volume of the channel in decibels. Change the volume at runtime with [method AudioMixerServer.set_channel_volume_db].

constants.constant: After an entry ends, the next entry plays. After the last entry, the channel stops and [signal AudioMixerServer.queue_finished] is emitted.
After an entry ends, the next entry plays. After the last entry, the queue starts again at the first entry.
After an entry ends, a random other entry plays. The queue never finishes.
